title: Duke and the Tune
lines: Ben has a cute mule, Duke.
Duke will not step up the path.
Ben yells at him. That is rude.
Duke just sits in the dust.
Ben hums a tune to Duke.
Duke gets up! That tune is fun.
Duke and Ben step up the path.

questions.ask: What does Duke do when Ben yells?
questions.listenFor: He just sits in the dust. Yelling did not work. Have them find that line if they are unsure.

questions.ask: What finally gets Duke to move?
questions.listenFor: Ben hums a tune. Listen for them naming the tune, not just "Ben was nice."

questions.ask: What do you think Ben will do the next time Duke stops? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer with a reason works. "Hum, because yelling did not work" shows they followed the whole story.
